profile.title: Profile
profile.description: These settings affect only your own account.
profile.effectiveHint: Where each of your permissions comes from: through which groups and which role. Groups or roles you cannot see show only their kind; ask an administrator about them.

password.title: Change password
password.hint: Changing your password signs you out of every device.
password.changed: Password changed. Please sign in again.

preference.title: Preferences
preference.description: Language and timezone are synced to your account.
preference.themeHint: Theme is saved on this device only and is not synced to your account.
preference.headerToolbarHint: Drag to reorder and toggle which tools appear in the header. Saved on this device only.

apiToken.title: Personal API tokens
apiToken.hint: Call the external API as yourself from personal scripts. They can do at most what you can. Changing your password, being signed out by an admin or being disabled invalidates them. Use a service account for long-lived integrations such as CI.
